newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers $20 mln in supplier credits to Brazil.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers $20 mln in supplier credits to Brazil.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday said it authorized $20 million in credit guarantees for sales of U.S. farmgoods to Brazil under the Supplier Credit Guarantee Program for fiscal 1997.
The program is an adaption of the GSM-102 program to assist exporters of U.S. agricultural commodities who wish to provide relatively short-term credit to their importers.
The eligible commodities include tree nuts, fresh, dried and canned fruit, fresh, frozen and canned vegetables, cotton, meat and planting seeds.
USDA said $10 million had been allocated to cover those commodities and that details about the allocation of the remaining $10 million would be issued later.
